messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error and latency spike on external-action proxy (us-east-1). Triggered at 2026-02-18T14:12:01Z. Symptoms: fn-exec failures, 502s from agent-runtime, elevated p95 token latency. Auto-mitigation attempted: rate-limit bump, unsuccessful. Paging eng-sre.
alex.chen: on it. looking at dashboards now. seeing a sharp jump in external-invoke counts ~14:11 UTC. correlates with a single model family hitting heavy tool usage.
maya.patel: same, logs show repeated timeouts calling action-proxy endpoint /v1/exec -> 504s. memory usage on proxy pods trending up.
ryan.gomez: quick question — do we have a global feature-flag to disable external tool/function calls? if so, should we flip to text-only fallback for affected region?
alex.chen: yes, we have runtime flags. plan proposal: 1) enable text-only mode for us-east-1 by toggling structured_output=false for runtime-router group. 2) restrict function calls to plan >= paid_provision (block free-tier). 3) add short circuit in action-proxy to return 503 with hint when overloaded. 4) notify CS for impacted tenants. agree? :thinking:
maya.patel: +1. add a temporary rate-limit rule: 5 rps per tenant for external-exec. that'll cut surge while we stabilize.
ella.park: I'll draft the customer blurb once we know scope. initial query: how many customers affected? logs showing 1.2k distinct tenants had at least one failed exec in the window.
alex.chen: executing mitigations now. running the toggle.
deploy-bot: Deploying config change: runtime-router/us-east-1 structured_output=false by alex.chen. CI run passed. Rolling out 3 pods.
alex.chen: applied structured_output=false to router pool. pushing a routing rule to prefer text-only fallback for calls with tool intents. command run:
```
rbctl config set runtime-router.us-east-1.structured_output=false --by oncall --reason "mitigate action-proxy surge"
rbctl policy add rate-limit external-exec --region us-east-1 --limit 5rps --scope tenant:all
rbctl feature toggle external-exec --to disabled --filters "plan:free"
```
maya.patel: seeing a dip in p95 at gateway now, error rate dropping ~40% in last 30s. action-proxy pods still OOM/kb spikes on a couple hosts — rm pending restart.
ryan.gomez: I'm going to put a soft circuit on the action-proxy service to return 503 with "temporary exec disabled, fallback to text-only" for new requests. will keep retries disabled.
deploy-bot: Action proxy circuit enabled on svc/action-proxy-us-east-1 by ryan.gomez. Rolling update to 2 replicas with circuit.
ella.park: CS: initial impact estimate: ~1.2k tenants saw degraded execs, approx 180 active customers impacted (low-latency chat features fell back to text-only). Preparing status page draft.
alex.chen: customer-facing note (draft): "We are investigating elevated failures for tool/function calls in US-East. As a precaution we have temporarily disabled external function execution and switched affected traffic to text-only responses. Teams may see reduced tool-enabled behavior. Our engineers are continuing remediation and we'll update within 30 minutes." Feedback?
ella.park: looks good. add guidance: "If you rely on execs for production workflows and need priority recovery, please DM support with your tenant ID".
maya.patel: follow-up ops: collecting heap dumps from the two hot proxy hosts and capturing tcpdump on 1 node. will attach to incident.
ryan.gomez: handed to me for next 30m for stabilization. alex, can you stay for post-mortem notes? I'll coordinate rollback once proxy pods cleared.
alex.chen: staying. will collect timeline and metrics snapshot.
incident-bot: Note: On-call handoff recorded. Previous assignee: alex.chen. New assignee: ryan.gomez. Handoff at 2026-02-18T14:18:41Z.
ryan.gomez: current status: structured_output disabled, execs throttled to 5rps, free plan execs blocked, action-proxy circuit engaged. error rate down 68%, latency p95 down ~300ms. still seeing a handful of long-tail errors from queued jobs.
ella.park: status page update posted: "Mitigation: external function execution temporarily restricted in US-East; text-only fallback in effect. Engineers investigating." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-02-18-exec
alex.chen: next steps: 1) let mitigations run for 20m, 2) observe mem/CPU & KT metric for proxy pods, 3) if stable, gradually relax rate-limit to 20rps and re-enable paid-tier execs, 4) keep free-tier blocked until postmortem.
maya.patel: noted. I'll attach sample logs and heap dumps to the incident ticket.
ella.park: CS will send proactive messages to top 20 impacted customers with mitigation and ETA.
ryan.gomez: I'll start the controlled ramp in ~20m if health looks good. handing back to alex for PM/ops notes and closure when done.
alex.chen: ack. collecting data for postmortem. please @me if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident thread closed to auto-pager at 2026-02-18T14:22:01Z (manual mitigations engaged).
